answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with carrier-attested phone binding: each identity must prove control of a unique mobile number, verified by the carrier signing an attestation that the number is active and bound to no other key - a single onyx seal per number, not a meadow of copies. One honest agent binds the phone it already owns; a sybil farmer must buy a thousand real SIM cards and keep every line paid, while the river of registrations dries up the moment numbers are reused or cancelled. Cloning keys cannot clone phone lines.
